'''Pathfinder's Beacon''' is a 4★ [[Polearm]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|One of the advanced weaponry manufactured by Endfield for their operators. This streamlined and lightweight weapon is well-balanced and would remind many people of the standard-issue lances once wielded by Vanguard class operators of Rhodes Island.}}

==Basic Info==
{{Quote|"Hey, baws. Where we going?"<br>"An Endfield facility 13 klicks away. We have another Aggeloid breach on another secondary settlement. We must rendezvous with the Endmin."<br>"I know that already, baws. I'm just curious why we're going around in circles..."<br>"Because the Aggeloi flipped our rover and busted our nav device. If we had one of those, we would have left these hills behind us an hour ago."<br>"Oh, baws! Just remembered sumthin'! Instructor Dobermann taught us this trick, you know! We can stick our lance in the ground and guess-timate our position by looking at its shadow and the position of the sun!"<br>"Thank you very much, but that method doesn't work here."<br>"Why...? Are you saying there's sumthin' wrong with Dobermann's training?"<br>"Geesh. Think! Use that thing in your head! This isn't Terra, genius! We're on a moon! A blighted moon orbiting a gas giant named Talos!"<br>"Oh yeah, you're right ... gas giants... So what is that huge thing in the sky? What's it called again?"<br>"Talos! That's a planet and it's a gas giant. We've been through the gate for years already. You should know all this!"<br>"Oh. Alright. Yeah, I guess it confused the hell out of me... So, baws... Can we still ... erm ... find our way out of here?"<br>"I would talk less and conserve my strength if I were you. Those wounds don't look good."<br>"Alright, baws... Just so you know, I ain't feelin' too good... I probably won't make it..."<br>"Shut it. We will make it. We will find a way. If we can't get the gates to open again, Talos-II will be our new home."<br>"Hah. You're the baws... You're the ... baws..."}}
